scope: 45 existing haptic and responsiveness JS checks; 40 production Java toolbar policy/action/geometry/feedback and existing haptic/routing checks against stubs; 25 real Chromium translucent bar/capsule alignment/3 locales/light-dark/portrait-landscape/real touch press/release/interruption/cancel/reduced-motion checks. The whole historical suite was not rerun. Native source and PDF classes were compiled together by the release build. A toolbar test fixture selector was corrected to select Done specifically; finite spring transitions are captured by transitionrun events to avoid CDP round-trip sampling after a completed transition.

limits.sourceSafeInsets: Display cutouts only; no stable hidden system-bar bands
limits.sourceToolbarScriptPolicy: Only bundled local press-state script, CSP self, no native bridge or arbitrary navigation

limitations: Actual Android immersive bars, cutout/IME handling and WebView composition were not tested on a physical Redmi K80 Pro.
External website sign-in and authenticated downloads retain the existing implementation but were not exercised against a live site.
Chromium validates local-toolbar text/geometry and shadow behavior, not native hardware performance or system gesture behavior.
